title: Enigma-Craft
description: small yet functional expansion modpack that  includes content expansions, Create addons, storage, QoL, magic, world-gen and more.
body:
# Enigma-Craft ""simple"" modpack

This modpack started as a small project for friends, but now it's been uploaded for anyone who wants to enjoy it.

Originally it was focused only on Create mod but it's been expanded for a better game experience including content expansions, Create addons, storage, QoL, magic, world-gen and more.
